meta.districtReference: India Post all-India PIN directory district list (36 States/UTs), with renamed districts updated to current official names and districts created after that list added (e.g. Rajasthan 2023 districts retained in 2024, MP 2023, CG 2022, Gujarat Vav-Tharad 2025). Every district is listed, including ones with 0 customers.
meta.howDistrictsWereAssigned: Each customer keeps every original field. Added fields: resolvedCountry, resolvedState, district, districtSource (pincode / city name / manual mapping / spelling corrected / state only), districtConfidence (high / medium / low / none). Original state/city values are unchanged.
